items.t: 16 ETFs Add to Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM) on Wednesday
items.sum: ETFs bought $74.5 million of Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM) shares on Wednesday, Nov. 18.

items.t: Taiwan Stocks Just Had Their Worst Week Since 1990 — And The AI Trade Is Unwinding From The East
items.sum: Taiwan's index had its worst week since 1990, as new U.S. export rules hit chips at 16nm. TSMC and the EWT ETF slid as the AI trade unwound.

items.t: Taiwan Stock Market Falls 6.2% to Cap Its Worst Week Since 1991 as KOSPI Closes Down 5.2% and Nikkei 225 Drops 5.1% in AI Chip Selloff
items.sum: Taiwan's stock market fell 6.2% on Friday to cap its worst week since 1991. The KOSPI closed down 5.2% and the Nikkei 225 dropped 5.1% in the AI chip selloff. Here are the closing numbers, the biggest stock moves and what they set up for Europe and Wall Street.

items.t: TSMC halts advanced chip orders from Chinese designers in Taiwan
items.sum: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSMC, TWSE: 2330) has suspended some advanced production orders from Chinese chip designers and will largely restrict those clients to older technology, Taipei Times reported on November 20, citing two sources with knowledge of the matter. The move follows new US export rules that came into force on November 19.

items.t: Taiwan Semiconductor Slipped 14% This Month Amidst Tech Contraction: 175% Gains to Materialize According to One Wall Street Desk
items.sum: Earnings estimates keep climbing while Taiwan Semiconductor's stock sinks with the rest of the chip sector. Is the selloff a warning about AI demand, or a rare entry point that one analyst values at nearly three times today's price?
